WITH district_client_counts AS (
    SELECT
        d.A3 AS region,
        d.district_id,
        COUNT(c.client_id) AS client_count
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN client AS c
        ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3, d.district_id
),
region_totals AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        SUM(client_count) AS total_clients,
        COUNT(*) AS district_count
    FROM district_client_counts
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT
    dcc.region,
    AVG(dcc.client_count) AS average_clients_per_district,
    AVG(1.0 * dcc.client_count / rt.total_clients) AS average_client_share_per_district
FROM district_client_counts AS dcc
JOIN region_totals AS rt
    ON rt.region = dcc.region
GROUP BY dcc.region;
